title: Chapter 166 Destiny Chaos (Reward Plus More)
content:
Chapter 166 Destiny Chaos (Reward Plus More)

The territory is thousands of miles, with millions of armor.

Hearing that the gloomy-looking scribe in front of him uttered such wild words, he exaggerated the strength of Yuguo to such an extent.

Although Yan Yi felt that it was impossible, but looking at the faces of the people in the tent, he was faintly proud, but felt that what he said seemed to be true.

So then? The strength of this imperial kingdom is not as simple as I imagined, their strength is extremely powerful. I am afraid that there is no one in the world who can compare with them, only the powerful empire in the west, Qin can compare with each other!

Thinking of this kind of speculation, Yan Yi's heart shuddered, but he quickly collected all his disdain, and kept all his disdain in his heart. He didn't dare to show it, and instead put on a more respectful demeanor.

"Well, of course, I'm not questioning His Majesty the Emperor of Yuguo. It's just that when I first heard this title, I was shocked and lost my mind!" Hearing Jia Xu's question, Yan Yi hurriedly apologized with a smile.

"Okay, Jia Aiqing, don't embarrass General Yan. You scare him. General Yan, I don't know what's important for you to come here on behalf of King Yan?" As a further performance of questioning, Zhong Yu spoke directly to Yan Yi and asked straightforwardly.

"His Royal Highness Prince Jing, the purpose of this minister's coming here is to represent King Yan and seek peace from the imperial kingdom!" Hearing that King Jing had already asked about something serious, Yan Yi also put away all the thoughts in his heart, and turned to said seriously.

"Oh, seek peace? Why is this? As far as Gu Wang knows, there are more than 100,000 troops in the capital of Yan Kingdom, tens of thousands of defenders in various places, and 100,000 frontier troops on the frontier. He is 300,000. His strength is not inferior to the army of our Yu Kingdom this time, why should he surrender like this?" Zhong Yu said playfully.

"Your Highness, please don't make jokes. Your Highness must be aware of the situation in Yan. The guards from all over the country stay in their places to maintain order, and they can't be mobilized at all. The border troops should stay behind and guard against the barbarians in the north and those from other countries in the south. Invasion cannot be mobilized either. With more than 100,000 defenders in the capital, self-defense is not enough, so how can we have the spare power to fight against the army of Yue?" Yan Yi said with a wry smile.

However, he revealed the current situation of the Yan Kingdom without any cover-up. He knew that the enemy in front of him knew the situation of the Yan Kingdom better than him, and it was useless to cover up.

"That's right, that's all, Gu Wang won't embarrass you. You said that Yan Guo wants to ask for peace, but what price can Yan Guo give? Let Gu Wang's 300,000 troops withdraw? You know, the mobilization of the army costs a lot of money. There are quite a few, without a satisfactory result, retreating here, the morale of the army will not be stable!"

Seeing that Yan Yi had directly pointed out, and even put Yan Guo's current weakness directly in front of him, Zhong Yu didn't pretend to be, and asked directly, what kind of benefits could Yan Guo give him to make him retreat .

"This time, His Highness's army is going out, apart from plundering Liaodong Shang County, I'm afraid it is to plunder the population and enrich the country where His Highness is located!" Yan Yi asked slowly, but he was trying to test whether his guess was right or not.

"That's right, the Guwang Yuguo covers tens of thousands of miles. Such a vast area is naturally sparsely populated, so I want to come to Yan to plunder and enrich the territory of our Yuguo!" Hearing Yan Yi's question, Zhong Yu didn't hide anything, and directly Speak up.

Anyway, in these situations, those who are interested only need to send some spies to the territory of Yuguo to investigate carefully, and they will be able to discover the news, which is useless now.

"Since Your Highness needs a population, my country of Yan is willing to export 200,000 people to subsidize Yuguo so that His Highness can retreat!" Hearing his guess, it was true, and Yan Yi felt relieved and said his own condition.

"No, 200,000 people is too small, even our army is not enough, we need 500,000 before our army can back down!" Zhong Yu flatly refused when he heard this number. Instead, the lion opened his mouth and asked for 500,000 yuan at once. Are you talking about business anyway? Constant discounts and price reductions are justified.

"Your Majesty, after taking 500,000, my country of Yan will be no different from being destroyed. How about 220,000?"

...

After some debate, Yan Yi finally reached a consensus with Zhong Yu, Yan Guo had the same population as Zhong Yu's army, and 300,000 people asked them to withdraw.

After Yuguo got the population, it also withdrew from the three counties in the west of Yanguo, and retreated to the three counties in Liaodong that had already been occupied.

Moreover, the Yan State must ensure that the people sent to the Yu State, and their family members, are the young men who are serving as soldiers for the Yan State.

It must also be sent to Yuguo to ensure that Yuguo gets these populations without the slightest problem of being controlled by Yanguo.

Fifteen days later, Zhong Yu, on behalf of Yuguo, built a high altar under the city gate of King Yan of Yanguo and made an oath to worship the heaven. Each agreed not to offend each other, and signed this agreement, which made countless Yan State officials and Yan State people cry endlessly.

And Zhong Yu also achieved his goal.

With the signing of this covenant, the war that attracted the eyes of all countries and countless forces came to an end and ended with the disastrous defeat of the Yan Kingdom.

After this raging war, the strength of the Yan Kingdom was greatly reduced, less than half of what it was before the war, and it was no longer the title of the hero of the Warring States.

Outside Jidu city, on a hill next to it, a woman in blue, with white hair and a beautiful figure, was standing on the top of the hill looking down into the distance.

A covenant that is destined to affect the fate of the world is being signed there. And this covenant is closely related to the appearance of this woman, indicating that he will come over in person to witness the birth of this covenant.

"He, what kind of person is he? Talking and laughing, destroying the country of people, conquering the army and destroying the city, doing nothing!" This is Xuenv in Feixue Pavilion who witnessed the beginning of this war with her own eyes.

And similarly, Prince Dan of Yan, who had been rescued by Concubine Yan and escaped from the battlefield at the head of the city of Yan Kingdom, also had a sad expression on his face at this moment. Tears couldn't help streaming down his eyes, and he looked down in pain. His father, the king of Yan, signed this extremely humiliating covenant with his deep-seated enemy.

"The matter won't end like this!" Yan Dan gritted his teeth and said this sentence.

And above the sky, there are several red mechanism birds hovering, on which are sitting the leaders of the Mohists like Master Ban, and they are also staring down at the moment.

They don't know where this sudden appearance of Yuguo will lead to the chaos in the world?

And in nowhere, there are countless eyes of countless people, closely watching the establishment of this covenant.

Yin-Yang School, Confucianism, Taoism, Famous School, Qin State, the other seven countries... All the countless forces in the world have come here. They have a premonition that this new country will bring a new fog to the world. , the direction of fate became chaotic again at this moment.
